themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within research contexts.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad spectrum of AI-powered tools utilized by researchers for analysis, discovery, and knowledge acquisition across various domains.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Discusses AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and analyzing code, including their impact on the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated user personas and data to simulate human behavior for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Covers the impact of AI on job creation, displacement, skill requirements, and the processes of hiring and workforce development.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications that automate software testing, quality assurance, and performance analysis.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Examines how AI is used in the design process, from concept generation and prototyping to UI/UX refinement.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, data, or media into concise summaries for quicker understanding.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers AI's role in analyzing customer data, behavior, and feedback to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Reviews and compares different AI tools for research, highlighting their features, performance, and suitability for specific tasks.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
